# vendor

Third-party assets, committed so the build needs no network and the app
needs no runtime CDN.

| file | source | licence |
|---|---|---|
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) v1.4.4 (unpkg, verbatim) | MIT (c) Kazuhiko Arase |

Poppins (`assets/fonts/*.woff2`, latin + latin-ext subsets, weights 400 and 800)
comes from Google Fonts and is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
